title: How to plan a 40th birthday dinner at home: menus and budgets
summary: Plan a 40th birthday dinner at home, with advice on menus, budgets, guest numbers and how a private chef booking comes together.
body_markdown:
For a 40th birthday at home, start with the people you want around the table and the kind of evening you would enjoy. A small dinner with close friends needs a different plan from a house full of guests arriving for drinks and food.


A[private chef for a birthday](https://yhangry.com/f/private-chefs/birthday) can take care of the cooking, but your guest count, room and budget shape what is possible. Decide those early and you can spend the rest of the planning on the details that feel personal to the birthday guest.


## **Choose the format before the menu**


For a seated dinner, check how many people can sit comfortably and how food will reach them. A long table can look lovely, but guests still need room to move and the chef needs space to serve.


If you want a larger group, discuss canapés, sharing food or another suitable format with the chef. Tell them whether guests should expect a full meal. Small bites over several hours are a different brief from dinner served all at once.


## **Make one or two details personal**


Choose a cuisine the birthday guest loves, a dish connected to a favourite trip or a dessert they always order. Give the chef that context rather than asking for a complicated theme on every course.


Personal touches don’t have to come from the food. One host planning a surprise 40th tasting menu at home gave every course a name drawn from her husband’s life, including a nod to how the couple met 22 years earlier.[Chef Anneliese B](https://yhangry.com/booking/chef/anneliese-b/) helped her shape the menu, handled a late dietary change and explained each dish to the table as it arrived, because the guests didn’t know what was coming.


Ask how the cake will fit into the meal. If you are buying one separately, agree storage and serving arrangements. A large dessert course followed straight away by cake may be more food than the group wants.


## **Set a complete budget**


Include the chef, ingredients and any extra staff or equipment, then allow separately for drinks and table items. Tell the chef your food budget and the guest count so you can design the menu together.


As a guide, here is what UK birthday dinners at home booked through yhangry cost between November 2025 and October 2026. These are total booking prices, based on 1,630 completed bookings:


The cost per head usually falls as the group grows. The median was about £104 per adult for groups of up to six, £78 for seven to ten, and £62 for larger groups (children counted as half). These figures show past bookings, not quotes. Your date, location, menu and chef will set the final price.


If guests are chipping in, agree the amount and how you’ll collect it early. Check the current booking payment terms rather than assuming everyone can pay separately on the night.


## **A real 40th birthday dinner**


In October 2026, a guest booked[Chef Robert C](https://yhangry.com/booking/chef/robert-c-6/) for her sister’s 40th birthday at a farmhouse in Mid Sussex. The brief was a casual party for 12 adults and three children, with two firm constraints. There could be no seafood at all, because one family member has a severe shellfish allergy, and as little dairy as possible, because some guests are intolerant.


Robert built a sharing feast around those constraints:


The total was £1,201.20, or about £100 per adult with the children’s menu included. The host rated the evening five stars. She said Robert helped tailor the menu before the day, and the whole group remarked on how much flavour the vegetable sides had.


The practical lesson is that sharing food suits a mixed group. With six vegan dishes on the table, the dairy-light request was handled without anyone getting a separate plate. A short children’s menu kept the younger guests happy without changing the main meal.


Use this example as inspiration rather than a fixed package. Your date, location, guest count and chef will determine the final proposal. You can read more real events in our[case studies](https://yhangry.com/blog/category/case-studies/) .

## **Give the evening a simple structure**


Allow time for guests to arrive before the meal, decide when speeches or a toast will happen and let the chef know. Ask someone other than the birthday guest to answer the door and handle practical questions.


Confirm dietary requirements, the final menu and the service plan before the day. Then leave room for the gathering to feel relaxed. You don’t need an activity scheduled between every course.

FAQs


How much does a private chef cost for a 40th birthday at home?


Across 1,630 completed UK birthday bookings at home on yhangry between November 2025 and October 2026, the median total was £676. Dinners for up to six guests had a median of £437, and groups of 11 or more had a median of £1,040. Your date, location, menu and chef will set the final price.


How many guests can a private chef cook for at home?


Your space usually sets the limit more than the chef does. Over the same period, 607 of those 1,630 birthday dinners were for 11 guests or more. For a bigger group, ask the chef about sharing dishes or canapés rather than a plated meal, and check you have enough seating.


How far ahead should I book?


For UK birthday dinners at home over the same period, the median gap between paying for the booking and the dinner itself was 27 days. Half of bookings were confirmed between 11 and 53 days ahead. That measures the confirmed booking, not the first enquiry, so allow time before it to compare proposals and agree the menu.


Does the chef bring the ingredients and clean up?


Yes. The chef shops for the ingredients, arrives about two hours before the meal to prepare, cooks and serves, and leaves your kitchen clean. If you’re short of equipment or crockery, say so in your request so the chef can bring what’s needed.


Can the chef cater for allergies and different diets?


Yes. Include every allergy and dietary requirement in your request, and confirm the final list before the day. In the example above, the whole menu was built without seafood because of a severe allergy, and six vegan dishes covered the request for less dairy.
